title: Fields of Discovery
description: Fields of Discovery is a Vanilla+ Modpack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience with a wide range of improvements and functional mods.
body:
Fields of Discovery is a Vanilla+ modpack, thoughtfully designed by Discord user The Individual for a rich multiplayer experience shared with friends on their private server. This modpack enhances the core Minecraft gameplay with a wide selection of mods, ranging from quality-of-life improvements like Tom's Simple Storage and Fabric Seasons to exciting content additions like Naturalist and Small Ships. Whether you're managing resources or exploring new worlds, Fields of Discovery brings a perfect balance of functionality and adventure, making it the ideal choice for both casual and dedicated players.

## Performance
Fields of discovery is a modpack designed with many preformance-enhancing elements that are implemented in order to help your game run smooth as butter.
